invariants.description: a follows the Tao 2011 steady state (Suppl. Eq. 99) from a(0) = 0: a = a_bar(Vm) (1 - exp(-t/tau_a)), using the module's own tau_a
tau_a equals Tao 2011 Suppl. Eq. 100 (ms) converted to seconds
ha follows the Tao 2011 steady state (Suppl. Eq. 101) from ha(0) = 0: ha = ha_bar(Vm) (1 - exp(-t/tau_ha)), using the module's own tau_ha
tau_ha equals Tao 2011 Suppl. Eq. 102 (ms) converted to seconds
i_A = g_A*a*ha*(Vm - E_K) (Tao 2011 Suppl.; the module's encoded form)

bc_sweep.rationale: clamp potential -90 to +30 mV (rest to action-potential peak of a sympathetic neuron); reversal potential +/-20 mV about the Tao value; conductances by 0.5-2.

baseline.reason: candidates: the voltage-clamp steady-state and time-constant data of Belluzzi & Sacchi (J Physiol 1985 358:91 I_A; 1986 380:275 I_Na; 1988 397:127 I_KV; 1989 412:493 I_Ca; 1990 422:561 I_KCa), e.g. tau_hc 17.6-29.3 ms; set up after the unit/sign fixes.

calibrate.note: not_applicable: kinetic constants are hard-coded in the CellML; only the maximal conductance is a parameter.
